name: Neighbourhood Cable
summary: Regional Victorian HFC cable provider (Mildura, Ballarat, Geelong); acquired by TransACT 2007, brand dropped 2011 (NEIGHBOURHOOD CABLE LIMITED (NOW TRANSACT VICTORIA HOLDINGS PTY LTD), ACN 000 042 295); retailed under the 'ncable' brand on ncable.net.au from c. 2000 (same entity — NEIGHBOURHOOD CABLE LIMITED, ACN 000 042 295; the 'ncable' site carried the same TransACT fate).

events.details: Network rollout commenced Mildura 1 March 1996; listed as Neighbourhood Cable Ltd 2000.
Brand dropped; rebranded as TransACT (which iiNet acquired Nov 2011).
